tutorial-dialog-1.description: Guard of the village not happy with you at all.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: Welcome to our village! You have chosen, or been chosen, to relocate to our finest... Oh, wait... Where have you come from, actually? Nevermind. This village is forbitten for outsiders, it says right there. See?

lines.name: Sign with text
lines.text: This village is forbidden for outsiders!

tutorial-dialog-2.description: Guard of the village not happy with you at all.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: Well, you got it: i'm standing here, conviniently blocking your path to the next location and there is no way you can make me disappear.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: Like poofff... Can you imagine? Bizarre!

tutorial-dialog-3.description: Guard of the village not happy with you at all.

lines.name: Consciousness
lines.text: Deep down, you already know the truth. There is a door you have not yet opened.

lines.name: Consciousness
lines.text: Press [V] to open File Explorer.

tutorial-dialog-4.description: Guard of the village not happy with you at all.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: I'm still here blocking your way, and you are still here staring at me. What do you want?

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: You can't just keep staring at me. I'm not going to disappear. You need to move on.

tutorial-dialog-5.description: Guard of the village not happy with you at all.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Let's try a more direct approach. This is a tutorial level. We want you to learn that you can alter the game world by deleting files. So go and delete that file!

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: These dialogs are not procedural generated. They will run out eventually. There is only so many you can write in seven days. I guess your playthrough will be longer then 15 minutes.

tutorial-dialog-7.description: Guard of the village not happy with you at all.

lines.text: I think, you just pretend you don't understand what we want from you.
What if I'm the main boss of this game? Imagine how fun it would be? For me.
I hope you are not using controller. I'm not sure how it would work with that.
Congratulations! You made it. You are the first person who have read all my lines. Thanks, very flattering.
Try to create file kick-my.ass

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: You erased the Guard’s file—every trace, every echo—together, with deliberate hands. The moment it vanishes, something stirs.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Power seeps into your limbs like heat through stone. Your breath deepens. Your thoughts race. For an instant, the world feels wider, softer at the edges, as though it might finally bend if you only reached out.

lines.name: Consciousness
lines.text: Wait a minute... This is not the Divinity Original Sin game or Baldurs Gate game or any other RPG game. This is a simple game about deleting files.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Yes, it is.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Ahem… The road to the village lies open. You can go there now!

dialog-guard-was-recreated.description: If guard was recreated, he will be confused.

lines.text: Ohh, we are not done here. I see...
Please, I just want it to be over.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: This building is surrounded by void mist — you can’t just walk inside. If we could retrieve an ancient sword from the old building, then we might be able to…

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: Wait — I see it at your belt! You’ve already found it!

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: We must learn the name of this house. Perhaps the village elder can help us with that. Or maybe you already know it?

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: We must hurry! We cannot allow this void mist to remain here any longer. Find my sword in the old house with the collapsed entrance!

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: Greetings! The entrance to the house is sealed. I can clearly sense the presence of a void curse here. I will need your help.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: To the southwest from here, there is a house with a collapsed entrance. It used to be a barracks. Find my sword there — it is special, and it will help us deal with this void.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: Excellent! You’ve found my sword! The runes upon it say that, to dispel this mist, this place must be returned to life.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: It exists, and yet it does not exist at the same time.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: We must learn the name of this house. Perhaps the village elder can help us with that.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: This is no time to stand around! We must learn the name of this house to pull it back from the void. If only I could remember it! Go to the village elder. He should have the answers.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: There is no time to lose. This house has a name, and that name will help us return it to reality. Run to the elder!

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: So, you’ve managed to learn the name of this house. Strange... how none of us could recall it, as if the very memory had been stricken from our minds...

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: Rebuild the 'assembly-hall' and we shall be able to enter and lift the curse from this village.

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: The assembly-hall is already rebuilt. We can enter and lift the curse from this village!

lines.name: Guard
lines.text: Something feels off. Like I’m in the wrong place, but I’m still here anyway.
